widgets_values:
Create a breathtaking 25-panel cinematic storyboard arranged in a 5×5 grid for a whimsical fantasy short film titled "The Whispering Grimoire". ALL 25 panels must contain fully rendered illustrations in a warm, cozy watercolor-and-ink style matching the provided reference image. NO empty frames. NO placeholder text-only panels.

SUBJECT: Elara, a young, curious apprentice mage with chestnut brown hair, freckles, and a red-and-gold scarf. She wears an oversized dark grey robe and brown boots. Her expression evolves from curiosity → wonder → determined focus → joyful triumph.

STYLE: Warm storybook illustration, soft watercolor textures, ink outlines, golden sunlight streaming through gothic windows, magical glowing particles (cyan and gold), cozy library atmosphere. High detail, charming, heartwarming.

---
25 PANELS (5 rows × 5 columns):

ROW 1 — THE DISCOVERY · 初遇秘典:
Panel 1: Wide establishing shot of the Grand Archives. Sunlight streams through tall arched windows, illuminating endless rows of wooden bookshelves. Dust motes dance in the light. Elara is a tiny figure walking down a long aisle, looking up in awe. Caption: "Grand Archives · Morning Light".
Panel 2: Medium shot. Elara stops at a restricted section. She reaches out to touch a thick, ancient book bound in dark leather with silver clasps. The book sits on a high shelf, slightly glowing. Her eyes are wide with curiosity. Caption: "The Forbidden Shelf".
Panel 3: Close-up. Elara’s hand gently pulls the book from the shelf. As she touches it, small cyan magical sparks erupt from her fingertips. The book feels warm and alive. Her face shows surprise and delight. Caption: "A Spark of Magic".
Panel 4: Extreme close-up of the book cover. Intricate silver embossing of stars and moons. The title "Whispering Grimoire" is faintly visible. The texture of the old leather and paper edges is detailed and tactile. Caption: "Ancient Secrets".
Panel 5: Medium shot. Elara hugs the book to her chest, smiling shyly. She looks around to make sure no one saw her take it. The library is quiet and peaceful. Golden light wraps around her like a blanket. Caption: "Stolen Moment".

ROW 2 — THE AWAKENING · 魔法苏醒:
Panel 6: Interior shot. Elara sits at a large wooden desk near a window. She opens the book. Instead of words, swirling blue and gold smoke rises from the pages, forming small shapes. Her hair blows slightly from the magical wind. Caption: "Pages Come Alive".
Panel 7: Close-up of Elara’s face. Her eyes reflect the glowing magic from the book. She giggles, her freckles prominent in the warm light. A small, translucent blue butterfly made of magic flies out of the book and lands on her nose. Caption: "Magic Butterfly".
Panel 8: Dynamic shot. The magic smoke expands, filling the room with floating geometric runes and symbols. Elara stands up, trying to catch them. Her scarf floats in the air. The atmosphere is chaotic but playful. Caption: "Runes Unbound".
Panel 9: Horror-comedy twist. A small, mischievous shadow creature (like a soot sprite) pops out of the book. It has big white eyes and grins. It grabs Elara’s quill pen and runs away across the desk. Elara looks shocked. Caption: "The Mischief Maker".
Panel 10: Action shot. Elara leaps over the desk, her robe billowing. She chases the shadow creature. Books slide off the table in slow motion. The scene is energetic and fun, not dangerous. Caption: "Chase Through the Stacks".

ROW 3 — THE CHASE · 追逐嬉戏:
Panel 11: Low-angle shot. The shadow creature scampers up a tall ladder between bookshelves. Elara looks up, hands on her hips, determined. Sunlight creates strong shadows on the floor. Caption: "Up We Go".
Panel 12: Medium shot. Elara climbs the ladder gracefully. Her boots grip the rungs. She is halfway up, surrounded by thousands of books. The shadow creature peeks out from behind a thick encyclopedia. Caption: "High Altitude Pursuit".
Panel 13: Close-up. Elara reaches out to grab the creature, but it dodges. Her fingers brush against a glowing blue rune on the spine of a nearby book. The rune pulses with light. Caption: "Almost Got It".
Panel 14: Wide shot from above. The shadow creature jumps from shelf to shelf, knocking over small stacks of books. Elara follows, using a minor levitation spell (glowing feet) to float between gaps. Her expression is focused. Caption: "Levitation Leap".
Panel 15: Dramatic angle. The creature corners itself on a high balcony railing. Elara lands softly opposite it. She holds out her hand, not to catch it, but to offer friendship. The creature hesitates. Caption: "Standoff".

ROW 4 — THE CONNECTION · 心灵链接:
Panel 16: Close-up of Elara’s face. Soft, empathetic expression. She smiles warmly at the creature. The background blurs into warm bokeh lights. Caption: "No Fear Here".
Panel 17: Close-up of the shadow creature. Its big eyes widen. It tilts its head. The aggressive grin softens into a curious look. It drops the stolen quill. Caption: "Curiosity Returns".
Panel 18: Medium shot. The creature slowly crawls toward Elara’s hand. As it gets closer, its black smoky form begins to shimmer with gold dust. Elara’s hand glows with a gentle welcoming light. Caption: "Trust Built".
Panel 19: Touch moment. The creature touches Elara’s finger. A burst of warm golden light explodes outward, silhouetting them both. The light is soft, not blinding. It signifies a bond formed. Caption: "The Bond".
Panel 20: Transformation shot. The shadow creature dissolves into pure light and flows back into the open Grimoire on the desk below. Elara watches it go, her hand still tingling with magic. She looks relieved and happy. Caption: "Return to Source".

ROW 5 — THE HARMONY · 和谐终章:
Panel 21: Medium shot. Elara descends the ladder, holding the Grimoire carefully. The library is messy with scattered books, but the atmosphere is serene. Sunlight is brighter now, afternoon gold. Caption: "Descent".
Panel 22: Detail shot. Elara uses a cleaning spell. A swirl of blue wind picks up the fallen books and neatly places them back on shelves. Her movements are elegant and practiced. Caption: "Tidying Up".
Panel 23: Close-up of the Grimoire. Elara closes the book. The silver clasps lock themselves with a soft click. A faint glow remains under the cover. She pats the cover affectionately. Caption: "Secret Kept".
Panel 24: Wide shot. Elara walks back down the main aisle, the Grimoire tucked under her arm. The library is perfectly ordered again. Shadows are long and warm. She hums a tune. Caption: "Walking Home".
Panel 25: Epilogue portrait. Elara sits by the window, reading the Grimoire openly now. The magic butterfly from Panel 7 rests on her shoulder. She looks directly at the viewer with a knowing, joyful smile. The sun sets outside, painting the sky orange and purple. Caption: "The End · New Beginnings".

---
DESIGN NOTES:
- Each panel MUST be fully illustrated in the warm watercolor/ink style.
- Panel borders: Thin, hand-drawn ink lines between cells.
- Add small English scene captions beneath each panel in a handwritten font.
- Overall composition: Cozy, magical, heartwarming.
- NO photorealism, NO dark horror elements, NO empty spaces.
- Title bar at top reads: "The Whispering Grimoire · Storyboard | 25 Panels".
